models.mechanism: The dawn-incursion reading is strengthened by an explicit environmental consequence. The panting rush in the focus ayah is now the first audible phase of a raid whose force strikes, arrives at dawn, and then throws up dust. The crossing is no longer only social or temporal; it disturbs the occupied ground and fills the scene with the raised matter of its passage.

structural_cues: 100:4 continues the فـ chain and uses a finite verb, فأثرن, making the newly revealed action an event caused by the prior agents.
The pronoun phrase به links the dust-raising back to the preceding motion or occasion, making a causal bridge more explicit than earlier stages.
The sequence now runs from panting approach to striking, dawn raid, and raised dust: sound, contact, time, environmental consequence.
ث و ر/B003 adds attack-surge language that reinforces the already activated raid branch ص ب ح/B004.

abductive_moves.assumption: The raised dust is the effect of the same collective rush that began with العاديات ضبحا.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies the linked فـ sequence and به, but does not spell out the full agent-continuity from the focus ayah to the dust cloud.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: panting runners, dawn raiders, then they stir dust thereby; inferred arrow: the initial boundary-crossing rush generates a physical dust cloud as its environmental signature.
alternatives: The dust could be only a scenic detail after the raid, not a mechanism that changes the focus reading.
به could point narrowly to the dawn attack rather than the whole sequence beginning with the panting runners.

changed_reading.before: At stage 2, the focus read as the audible first stage of a dawn incursion that strikes and alarms.
changed_reading.after: After 100:4, the focus reads as the beginning of a force that not only raids but physically unsettles the ground, raising a dust-cloud proof of its boundary-crossing passage.

models.ablation: Removing 100:4 ث و ر/B002 or ن ق ع/B004 leaves the strong stage-2 dawn-raid model but removes the new environmental proof of disturbance. Removing 100:1 ع د و/B001 leaves dust raised by motion, but not a focus-root reading of boundary-crossing incursion.

models.mechanism: The material-trace reading is revised from fire-and-light toward particulate upheaval. At stage 2, panting led into sparks and dawn visibility; 100:4 adds that the same force raises dust. The focus breath now belongs to a chain of matter becoming airborne: hot spark, dawn light, then dust that can obscure or thicken the visible scene.

structural_cues: 100:4 gives the material result that stage 2 only inferred: the movement stirs up a visible medium.
The sequence of manner/result nouns now includes ضبحا, قدحا, صبحا, نقعا, moving from breath to spark to dawn to dust.
ث و ر/B001 and ن ق ع/B004 both specify matter rising after stillness, matching ع د و/B010's hard dry ground.
The new dust revises the dawn-light reading by adding opacity: the scene becomes visible at dawn and then is thickened by a cloud.

abductive_moves.assumption: Spark and dust are two material releases caused by the same impact chain begun by the panting rush.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies striking sparks and dust-raising, but the shared impact mechanism is inferred by linking the sequential clauses.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: running breath, striking fire, dawn, stirred dust; inferred arrow: rapid contact with dry ground first releases sparks and then dislodges particulate matter into the air.
alternatives: The dust may be a separate result of movement after the spark image, not a revision of the fire mechanism.
The ash branch of ض ب ح may remain only a dormant analogy rather than a bridge to نقع dust.

changed_reading.before: At stage 2, the focus panting was the dark pre-visible phase of a transformation into sparks and dawn light.
changed_reading.after: After 100:4, the focus panting begins a broader material upheaval: breath and impact convert hidden or settled matter into sparks, light, and finally a raised dust cloud.

models.ablation: Removing 100:4 ث و ر/B001 or ن ق ع/B004 leaves the stage-2 fire-and-dawn model intact but removes the new particulate upheaval. Removing ع د و/B010 weakens the dry-ground mechanism that explains why running would release dust.

models.mechanism: The timed-exertion reading is revised into transmitted momentum. Panting is still bodily cost, but 100:4 shows that the expended force does work on the world: it displaces settled dust. The focus ayah therefore reads as the start of a transfer from internal pressure to external turbulence.

structural_cues: The finite verb فأثرن introduces an explicit action by the plural agents, not merely another descriptive noun.
The phrase به supports a reading of instrumentality or consequence: by it, or thereby, dust is raised.
The sequence now gives a clear transfer path: breathing body, striking contact, timed arrival, displaced dust.
100:4 changes the expenditure model from internal strain plus timing into externally measurable turbulence.

abductive_moves.assumption: Panting indexes the amount of force that will later be visible as dust displacement.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies bodily panting and dust stirring, but not a quantified or physical momentum theory connecting them.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: running with audible breath and later stirring dust thereby; inferred arrow: bodily exertion produces momentum, and momentum displaces settled matter.
alternatives: Panting may remain only an animal sound while dust is a separate scenic consequence.
The dust could be caused by number or terrain rather than by the intensity signaled in ضبحا.

changed_reading.before: At stage 2, the focus also read as timed strain toward morning arrival.
changed_reading.after: After 100:4, the focus reads as bodily pressure that becomes environmental turbulence: the panting marks force sufficient to stir settled dust.

models.ablation: Removing 100:4 leaves the stage-2 timed-exertion model but removes the new proof that exertion acts on the environment. Removing ض ب ح/B001 leaves external dust-raising but not the focus-specific reading of internal pressure becoming turbulence.

surprise_reading: With 100:4 added, the panting racers become the start of a force that visibly unsettles the world. The raid model is strengthened: breath, strike, dawn alarm, then dust raised by incursion. The fire/light model is revised into a broader material upheaval, where sparks and dust are paired releases from impact. The exertion model is revised as transmitted momentum: panting pressure becomes external turbulence.
